# AGI Counsel Network (https://agicounsel.org)

> Independent peer community for legal professionals across the AI ecosystem: Applications, Models, Infrastructure, Chips, and Energy.

## Core Thesis
Intelligence expands possibility. Judgment shapes what comes next.

## Flagship Research & Community Notes
- [What Would an AI-Native Legal Department Look Like? (AGI Counsel Note #01 - English)](https://agicounsel.org/notes/ai-native-legal-department/): Systems-level observations from AGI Counsel Network's inaugural closed-door peer roundtable on the Three Structural Shifts from Legal Production to Legal Judgment (1. End-to-End Workflow Redesign, 2. Compounding Institutional Memory Flywheels, 3. Accountable Human Governance & Chief-of-Staff Multi-Agent Orchestration).
- [AI 原生法务部门会是什么样？ (AGI Counsel Note #01 - 中文版)](https://agicounsel.org/zh/notes/ai-native-legal-department/): 系统剖析从法律生产到法律判断的三重跃迁（端到端工作流重构、自学习知识飞轮、律师作为多 Agent 集群参谋长 Chief of Staff 的治理机制）及跨国实体企业落地四大铁律。
